sources.facts: The entrance is approximately forty yards horizontally and seventy-five feet high. The cavern descends approximately eighty feet into the mountain, and ceremonial ice formations are seasonal.
Jammu and Kashmir’s official district description places the shrine in a Himalayan cave at approximately 3,888 m.
The 1970 British Karst Research Expedition describes the shrine in the Amarnath limestone valley, with massive limestone and thinner limestone beds.
Valley survey independently identifies the shrine on the north side of the glacial valley, consistent with the entrance facing south. Its published longitude differs by about 42 m.

mapPinNote: Selected the named mapped entrance, ahead of the mapped terrace paths. The approximate Wikidata story longitude is more than a kilometre east and does not match the cave mouth.
